Topic T1 · First Impression

Where You'd Find It
The VMI bin card this module is named after — Item D4 lives in cell D4 of this catalog card (outlined in orange).
The physical bin: each labeled lid position lines up with a compartment below it.

What You'd Notice Picking This Up Cold

Item D4 is a small plastic push-in clip. Its flat round head sits on top of the panel, and its ribbed, tree-like shaft is what gives the Pine-Tree Clip its name.

Name

Pine-Tree Clip — a removable, reusable panel fastener.

Self-Centering Shaft

A ribbed shaft with fins that lets it be pushed in and pulled out without distorting the retaining fins.

Material

Plastic — Nylon 6/6, plain finish.

Item D4: flat round head, ribbed shaft, tapered tip.

The part number /BOMBA173 says nothing about the clip's shape or material — it points back to a catalog and a supplier name. See .

Reading a Catalog Part Number

Not every SBS part number spells out its specifications. /BOMBA173 is a catalog part number — it tells you where the part comes from and which catalog number to look up. This module follows the part from the bin to the print to the inspection bench.

  • Ideal for fastening applications like Pine-Tree Clips.

Where Pine-Tree Clips Are Used

Home Appliances

Electronics

Mounting circuit boards or internal components.

Aerospace Industry

Wrap-Up

Nice Work — Module Complete

You've worked through Item D4 end to end. Here's a quick recap of what this module covered before you take the knowledge check and share your feedback.

  • Part number. /BOMBA173 is a catalog part: a leading “/”, the first five letters of the supplier’s name, and the catalog part number.
  • Finding it. Search the SBS e-catalog for the item page and 3D model; the ERP’s Item Master Inquiry holds the full record.
  • Print & inspection. The catalog row 2619-00 gives the dimensions; the inspection template checks head diameter, head height, tip length and body length.
  • Material & use. Nylon 6/6 plastic, plain finish — used for interior panels and housings across automotive, appliance, electronics and aerospace work.

Reference

Glossary

Every code, acronym, and term used in this module, defined in plain language. Tap a term’s “jump” button to see it in context.

BRP

Bombardier Recreational Products — the customer behind this part. Its part number, 293730016, is linked to /BOMBA173 on the item record and the inspection report.

Catalog Part

A part specified by a catalog page rather than a custom print. The leading “/” in the part number marks a catalog or print part.

ERP / Item Master Inquiry

The SBS business system and the screen that shows how an item is set up — description, item classes, inventory, document links and more.

ITW Fastex

The catalog source named in the item’s extended description (ITW FASTEX # 2619-00-5869).

Nylon 6/6

An engineering-grade polymer (polyamide) with an excellent combination of mechanical, thermal and chemical properties — the material and grade of this clip.

Panel Range

The thickness range of panel a push-in clip is made to grip, shown as a minimum and maximum in the catalog table. For this clip: 0.079 to 0.236.

PPAP

Production Part Approval Process — the documentation package a supplier submits to prove its process can reliably make a part to print. This item is at PPAP Level 4.

Pine-Tree Clip

A removable, reusable push-in panel fastener with a ribbed, self-centering shaft whose fins are not distorted by insertion or removal.

VMI (Vendor-Managed Inventory)

A bin system where SBS manages and restocks parts directly at the customer’s location. This training module is named after Item D4’s cell on the VMI bin card.

VMM (Video Measuring Machine)

An optical instrument that measures small dimensions without touching the part. The inspection template calls for it on head height (D) and tip length (B).
